user.title: Connect to an OEC broker
user.description: The Message Bus of an OI4 Open Edge Computing 2.0 node (MQTT 3.1.1 over TLS). Home Assistant joins the bus as an OEC application.

data_description.host: DNS name or IP address of the broker as in its certificate (broker.json Address).
data_description.port: Secure port of the broker (broker.json SecurePort).
data_description.ca_cert: Certificate of the CA that signed the broker certificate. Leave empty to use the system trust store.
data_description.auth: How Home Assistant authenticates to the broker.

data_description.key_password: Only if the private key is encrypted.

error.tls_error: The TLS connection failed: check the CA certificate and that the host matches the broker certificate.
error.invalid_tls: The CA certificate, client certificate or private key is invalid.
